response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) as benchmark_rate FROM fees) SELECT AVG(per_order.avg_rebtotal) as avg_rebate, AVG(per_order.avg_net_fee_rate) as avg_net_fee, AVG(per_order.avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark.benchmark_rate) as avg_excess FROM per_order, benchmark WHERE per_order.avg_net_fee_rate > benchmark.benchmark_rate

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude fee records with NULL orderslink (those with no associated order) from the final result, interpreting 'orders' to refer only to non-NULL order references.
